privacy.metaDescription: Read our privacy policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.body: When you use our service, we may collect personal information such as your name, email address, and profile picture, primarily when you register or log in using third-party services like Google or Facebook.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.lead: We use the information we collect to:
s2.item1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services;
s2.item2: Personalize your reading experience and bookshelf;
s2.item3: Authenticate your identity via email/password or OAuth providers;
s2.item4: Communicate with you regarding updates, security alerts, and account-related notices.

s3.title: 3. Data Sharing
s3.body: We do not sell your personal data. We only share data with third-party authentication providers (Google, Facebook) to facilitate secure sign-in flows.

s4.title: 4. Data Deletion and Retention
s4.body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You can request deletion of your account and all associated personal data at any time by contacting us at {b}, or by following the Data Deletion Instructions.

s5.title: 5. Contact Us
s5.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at {b}.

terms.metaDescription: Read our terms of service to understand the rules and guidelines for using our digital library.
terms.title: Terms of Service

s1.title: 1. Agreement to Terms
s1.body: By accessing or using Bibliaris, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to all terms, you may not access or use our platform.

s2.title: 2. Accounts and Registration
s2.body: To use certain features, you must register for an account. You agree to provide accurate information and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity on your account.

s3.title: 3. Use of Content
s3.body: All books, audiobooks, metadata, images, and other materials on Bibliaris are the intellectual property of Bibliaris or its licensors. You may access this content strictly for personal, non-commercial use.

s4.title: 4. Termination
s4.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account or access to the platform at our sole discretion, without notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms or is harmful to other users or our business interests.

s5.title: 5. Contact Us
s5.body: For any questions regarding these Terms, please reach out to us at {b}.

deletion.metaDescription: Instructions on how to request the deletion of your account and personal data associated with Bibliaris.
deletion.title: Data Deletion Instructions
deletion.intro: Bibliaris uses Facebook Login for authentication. According to Facebook Platform rules, we provide a way for users to request the deletion of their data associated with our application.
deletion.stepsLead: If you want to delete your activities and data associated with Bibliaris, you can do so by following these steps:
deletion.step1Path: Settings & Privacy > Settings > Apps and Websites
deletion.step4: Alternatively, you can send an email directly to {b} with your request. We will process your request and delete all your user profile data (email, name, avatar, and customized bookshelf entries) from our database within 24 hours.
deletion.confirmationBody: Upon receiving and processing your request, we will send a confirmation email to the address associated with your profile confirming that all personal information has been permanently removed from our active databases.
